dedupe_keys.name: italian ministry of infrastructure and transport open data portal dati mit gov it

description: The open data portal of the Italian Ministry of Infrastructure and Transport is a CKAN catalogue that holds 71 datasets on Italian transport infrastructure and services. It includes port infrastructure by port, maritime state concessions (updated August 2026, in SHP and CSV), the AINOP list of public works, road accident series for 2001 to 2018, the ANAS road graph and average daily traffic, air traffic for 2012, 2017 and 2018, Motorways of the Sea routes, freight villages (interporti), certified airports, cycle routes, programme contracts with RFI and ANAS, transport strikes and local public transport. The data come from the ministry and its agencies. Coverage is national (Italy). Datasets can be downloaded from the portal and through the CKAN API in formats such as CSV and SHP. Most are free under CC BY 4.0 (57 datasets), with six under IODL 2.0, one under CC0 and seven under a generic attribution licence. Caveats: many series are one-off or several years old, and dataset documentation is in Italian. The catalogue supports network models of Italian roads, ports and freight villages, exposure studies of transport assets and capacity planning. It complements the ANAS road graph, the Transport Regulation Authority open data and the ENAC air traffic dashboard catalogued here.
